nodes.title: Accountable people
nodes.description: A senior person is accountable for AI governance overall, and each AI system in use has a named owner. Guidance: https://www.ai.gov.au/staying-safe-and-responsible/essential-ai-practices/guidance-ai-adoption-foundations

nodes.title: Supply chain accountabilities
nodes.description: Responsibilities are agreed with the suppliers, developers and integrators of each AI system. Guidance: https://www.ai.gov.au/staying-safe-and-responsible/essential-ai-practices/guidance-ai-adoption-foundations

nodes.title: AI literacy and training
nodes.description: The people accountable for, using or overseeing AI are trained to understand its risks and limits. Guidance: https://www.ai.gov.au/staying-safe-and-responsible/essential-ai-practices/guidance-ai-adoption-foundations

nodes.title: AI governance framework
nodes.description: An AI policy, growing into a governance framework of policies and procedures, sets how AI is used. Guidance: https://www.ai.gov.au/staying-safe-and-responsible/essential-ai-practices/guidance-ai-adoption-foundations

nodes.title: Identify and engage stakeholders
nodes.description: The people an AI system affects are identified, with its possible harms, and engaged through its life. Guidance: https://www.ai.gov.au/staying-safe-and-responsible/essential-ai-practices/guidance-ai-adoption-foundations

nodes.title: Establish feedback and redress processes
nodes.description: People can question or challenge an AI decision, and harms can be put right, in proportion to the impact. Guidance: https://www.ai.gov.au/staying-safe-and-responsible/essential-ai-practices/guidance-ai-adoption-foundations

nodes.title: Monitor for systemic issues
nodes.description: Feedback and outcomes are watched for patterns of unwanted impact across the system. Guidance: https://www.ai.gov.au/staying-safe-and-responsible/essential-ai-practices/guidance-ai-adoption-foundations

nodes.title: Establish a fit-for-purpose risk management framework
nodes.description: The risk method suits the kinds of AI in use, from simple features to general-purpose and agentic AI. Guidance: https://www.ai.gov.au/staying-safe-and-responsible/essential-ai-practices/guidance-ai-adoption-foundations

nodes.title: Assess AI system risks
nodes.description: Each AI system or use is screened, and the riskier ones are assessed with a plan to reduce their risks. Guidance: https://www.ai.gov.au/staying-safe-and-responsible/essential-ai-practices/guidance-ai-adoption-foundations

nodes.title: Implement controls for AI system risks
nodes.description: Controls are applied in proportion to each AI use's risk. Guidance: https://www.ai.gov.au/staying-safe-and-responsible/essential-ai-practices/guidance-ai-adoption-foundations

nodes.title: Monitor and report incidents
nodes.description: AI incidents are recorded, investigated and learned from. Guidance: https://www.ai.gov.au/staying-safe-and-responsible/essential-ai-practices/guidance-ai-adoption-foundations

nodes.title: Maintain an AI register
nodes.description: A register lists every AI system, built or bought, including AI inside other products. Guidance: https://www.ai.gov.au/staying-safe-and-responsible/essential-ai-practices/guidance-ai-adoption-foundations

nodes.title: AI system transparency and explainability
nodes.description: People are told when AI is used, what it can and cannot do, and why it gave an outcome, in proportion to the stakes. Guidance: https://www.ai.gov.au/staying-safe-and-responsible/essential-ai-practices/guidance-ai-adoption-foundations

nodes.title: Supply chain transparency
nodes.description: What each AI system is built from, including its components and data sources, is known along the supply chain. Guidance: https://www.ai.gov.au/staying-safe-and-responsible/essential-ai-practices/guidance-ai-adoption-foundations

nodes.title: AI-generated content transparency
nodes.description: Content made by AI is identifiable as such where that matters. Guidance: https://www.ai.gov.au/staying-safe-and-responsible/essential-ai-practices/guidance-ai-adoption-foundations

nodes.title: Pre-deployment testing
nodes.description: Each AI system is tested, or its supplier's testing is checked, before it is relied on. Guidance: https://www.ai.gov.au/staying-safe-and-responsible/essential-ai-practices/guidance-ai-adoption-foundations

nodes.title: Monitor system performance
nodes.description: Each AI system in use is monitored in proportion to its risk, watching for new risks. Guidance: https://www.ai.gov.au/staying-safe-and-responsible/essential-ai-practices/guidance-ai-adoption-foundations

nodes.title: Conduct additional testing proportionate to risk
nodes.description: Riskier AI systems get further testing, such as stress tests or independent testing, before and after major changes. Guidance: https://www.ai.gov.au/staying-safe-and-responsible/essential-ai-practices/guidance-ai-adoption-foundations

nodes.title: Implement robust data and cybersecurity measures
nodes.description: Data governance and cyber security practices cover the needs of AI systems. Guidance: https://www.ai.gov.au/staying-safe-and-responsible/essential-ai-practices/guidance-ai-adoption-foundations

nodes.title: Maintain human oversight and control
nodes.description: Oversight matches each system's autonomy and stakes, with points where a person can pause, override or stop it. Guidance: https://www.ai.gov.au/staying-safe-and-responsible/essential-ai-practices/guidance-ai-adoption-foundations

nodes.title: Decommission when appropriate
nodes.description: An AI system can be retired safely, with another way to keep critical work going. Guidance: https://www.ai.gov.au/staying-safe-and-responsible/essential-ai-practices/guidance-ai-adoption-foundations
